title_zh: 确定社区义卖宣传不含博彩活动

scenario.label_zh: 确定社区义卖宣传不含博彩活动
scenario.goal_zh: 发现通用海报与活动安排不符，并约定删除博彩内容、改列实际摊位

context_zh: 社区义卖组织者使用设计模板制作海报；本次活动已决定只有手工作品与二手书摊位，没有博彩活动。
author: author-phase11-a

sentences.speaker: Bryn
sentences.text: This generic poster template advertises gambling, but we are not running any games for money.

sentences.speaker: Sal
sentences.text: That must be left over from the template. Our fair is just craft stalls and second-hand books.

sentences.speaker: Bryn
sentences.text: Then we should remove the casino-night line, not merely hide it in small print.

sentences.speaker: Sal
sentences.text: Absolutely. I'll replace it with the two types of stall and send you a proof.

sentences.speaker: Bryn
sentences.text: Thanks. We should check the whole poster before printing, in case any other template text remains.
